source_policy: Trainer code is the upstream R1-V commit plus the edits listed under files. Run artifacts are the recorded run's outputs. Only a home-directory path in one log line and the launch script's default values were rewritten; no metric value was changed.
added_files: workspace/run_grpo.sh (launch script written for this run)
workspace/eval_checkpoints.py (per-checkpoint held-out evaluation written for this run)
dropped: upstream docs, images, eval scripts and the unused distill_r1 package
run_notes: The recorded run received its reward list, step budget, save interval, learning rate and KL coefficient through environment variables. The shipped run_grpo.sh carries the same five values as its defaults, so that the script alone reproduces the recorded command line. The job hit its wall-time limit during the evaluation of checkpoint-125; a second invocation of eval_checkpoints.py (--steps 125,150) finished the series, which is why results/eval.log has two headers and results/eval_metrics.jsonl has the step-125 val line twice with identical values.

replacements.detail: Added count_reward and strict_format_reward and registered them as `count` and `sformat`; load the training set with load_from_disk when --dataset_name is a directory; build the prompt columns without re-encoding the image column; reworded QUESTION_TEMPLATE; emptied the model-card tags. These edits were in place before the recorded run.
Emptied the model-card tags. Not used by the recorded run.
Five `${VAR:-default}` values (reward list, step budget, save interval, learning rate, KL coefficient) were set to the values the recorded run received through its environment. No other line changed.
Line 2 only, a `df` warning about a missing autotune cache directory.
